title: ENVIRONMENT SHEET
headline: SHOT 07  |  WALRUS IN THE FISHMONGER'S VAN  |  SCOTTISH HARBOUR QUAY
subtitle: FIXED HARBOURSIDE CCTV FACING THE BAY   -   OVERCAST MIDDAY, DAMP, 2012   -   PANEL 1 IS THE CAMERA'S VIEW (16:9)

panels.title: CAMERA POV
panels.subtitle: The static CCTV view - exactly what the video frame shows
legend: CAMERA'S VIEW  |  16:9, fixed, ~3 m up on the harbourside building, wide lens, looking out over the quay to the bay
The van drives in from the right edge, turns right into the empty centre space, rear toward the camera. See panel 2.

marks.label: VAN ENTERS HERE FROM OFF-FRAME RIGHT
ICE + FISH HEADS LAND HERE (ROAD BEHIND VAN)

panels.title: TOP-DOWN VIEW
panels.subtitle: Bird's-eye site plan - the single source of truth for positions and the van's path
legend: PLAN VIEW  |  the camera sits at the BOTTOM of this plan (on the building roofline) looking UP toward the bay
Orange = the van's path (straight in from the right, right turn into the space) and action points. Teal = fixed structure.

marks.label: VAN PATH: IN FROM RIGHT, TURNS RIGHT
CAMERA BUILDING (CCTV ON ITS FRONT WALL)

panels.title: REVERSE VIEW
panels.subtitle: Spatial reference ONLY - NOT camera output. From the quay railing, looking back at the camera
legend: REVERSE ANGLE  |  standing at the quay railing, looking back across the parking and road at the building
Left and right are swapped vs. the camera's view. The real camera never sees this.

panels.title: LANDMARK DETAIL
panels.subtitle: The recurring set objects the video prompts refer to by name
legend: A VAN'S PARKING SPACE  |  B SLIPWAY  |  C VAN REAR (ROLLER DOOR CLOSED, LIFT STOWED)  |  D FISH BOXES + ROPE
These objects must look identical in every frame of the video.

marks.label: C  VAN REAR: DOOR CLOSED, LIFT STOWED
